translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Rhooan Pweipwogin Kkepas Kkewe Naiun John
Igiwe Jesus a moannon akkiuneeor rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun iwe seig me riiurhai, a noa saengi pwiuneoi we iwe a noa fenai me oaronga fetaeneei wooan oanongaen aepinoamw kkewe pwiuneoi we.
Nge oatowe John Baptist a rongorong me noan imwaen kanepwus wunuunun engaang kkewe Kristus a feeorin, a fangenoa aaemweoi rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun reen.
Iwe, ra aeiineow Jesus pwe, “Een miniwe re iura pwe epwe itto, aere aeipwe wewweti erhai?”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Oaw sefaaen noa oawwa aengaeni John minne oawwa rongorong me weri:
rhooa masparh ra ffatenoa, rhooa pirhemae ra faaeraeg, rhooa kaenepaai ra gacch noa, rhooa saeningapiung ra rongorong, rhooa mae ra menawtae, nge Kkepas Mwamwaai we a fenai ngaeniir rhooa affayeo.
Ifa mwo wenepwuweer rhooa se tip mwaramwar reei!”

Oatowe rhooawe naiun John ra noa, Jesus a kkepas ngaeniir aeremas kkewe reen wunuunun John: “Igiwe oawwa noa reen John noan desert we, meeta minne oaw niuwaennei pwe oawpwe noa weri? Efoarh fetin e mwoaroro reen aaeng?
Meeta minne oawnoa pwe oawpwe weri? Erhai mwaaen e memmengaag tae mengaag nning? Aeremas kka e ina wusun mengaagiiur nge reno noan imwaen king!
Aengaeniaei, meeta rhag oawnoa pwe oawpwe weri? Erhai profeta? Ooa, ennetaen, oawwa weri erhai e taegias saengi erhai profeta.
Pwe John miniwe Pwapwior we e Santus e iura pwe, ‘Deus a kkepas, ngaang ipwene fangetiw naeyi rhooan pweipwogin kkepas me weni mmwoamw pwe epwe noa maeneti ennepoamw.’
Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe John Baptist ina e taegias saengiir aeremas towunap kka reno wooan soanop. Iwe nge manna oarosaen git me noan Mweoiu Naaeng ina e taegias saengi John.
Saengi rhag oaton we John Baptist a rhaepetae aan fenai toorito igina nge miniwe Mweoiu Naaeng a toonong noan waeiraes pwe aeremas aenneew ra fiiow wooan pwe repwe nemaeni.
Toorito oatowe John a no, oanongeer profeta me Anniug kkewe aaen Moses ra aepesa wunuunun miniwe Mweoiu Naaeng;
nge aere oawwa niugiuw aar fenai, John nge iiy Elijah, iwe ra fasiun aepesa noa pwe epwe itto.
Iyo eyor saeningan, epwe rongorong!
“Iwe, meeta ipwe aweweei ngaeniir aeremesaen mweoi e igina? Ra aeffitaeg ngaeniir rhag wonigaet kkewe remooat noan nenien chuwaai. Eew mwiirh nge re iyaekkepwas ngaeniir aaemweoi,
‘Aemaem aeiya pwan kker ngaenigaemi, nge aaemi oawse maan! Aemaem aeiya arhiuwerhiuw, nge aaemi oawse saeng!’
Igiwe John a itto, e aecchigipin nge ese pwan iun wine, nge aeremas ra aepesa pwe, ‘Iiy eyor aniu aenneew wooan!’

Nge igiwe Naiun Aeremas e itto, a mwommwongo nge e iun, nge aeremas ra aepesa pwe, ‘Oaw pipiiy mwaaen een! Iiy erhai mwaaen mwongonap me iun wine, nge maereyaereer rhooan iyoiyon tax me rhooa monofit.’ Iwe nge minna repiaen Deus reepiy a pwae noa pwe ennet reen meeta a feeori.”
Aepinoamw Kkewe Rese Niugiuniug
Aeremesaen aepinoamw kkewe Jesus a feeori towunepaen kkeman kkewe aan me ee ina rese toagun saengi aar monofit, iwe Jesus a soong ngaeniir.

“Ifa mwo aenneewan ngaenigaemi, aaemi rhooan Chorazin me Bethsaida! Aere kkeman kka refeeori me wooan igeei minne refeeori me wooan Tyre me Sidon, ina nge aeremesaen aepinoamw kenaan a ssiunaei rhag aar memmengaag tutu nge re oamworomwor tae fenang wooar, pwe epwe pwae noa aar toagun saengi monofit!
Ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe noan Raaenin Apwiung nge Deus epwe faayeow re Tyre me Sidon me mmwaemi.
Nge een Capernaum! Wo tipaeni wopwe tooritae naaeng? Een wopwe ppiungiutiw noan nifierno! Aere kkeman kkewe effeeor me reemw epwan ffeeor me noan Sodom, epwe rhiuwen no rhag igina.
Ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe noan Raaenin Apwiung nge Deus epwe faayeow re Sodom me mmwoamw.”
Oaw Itto Aseoseo Reei

Reen oatowe nge Jesus a aepesa pwe, “Semaei, Soamwoonin naaeng me soanop, iya ngaenneog oamw aerhigerhig, pwe wa oapanoa minikkeei saengiir rhooa reepiy me metefaaegini, nge wa pwaeri ngaeniir rhooa kkewe reweer wonigaet.
Ennet, Semaei, pwe ina minna wo tipaeni epwe wen.”

“Semaei a ngaenneaei oanongaen meeta. Esooar erhai ne e giuneei minna Naiun, pwe aeggaen minna Seman rhag, nge esooar erhai e giuneei minna Seman, pwe iiy rhag minna Naiun, iwe me iyo kena minna Naiun a finiir tae pwe epwe pwaeri ngaeniir.
“Oaw itto reei oanongaemi rhooakkena oawwa aerhig reen pweipwogin mini cchoaw, pwe ngaang ipwe asseoseogaemi.
Oaw pwigi yoke
e aaei nge oawwa iseni tae woami, nge oawwa kapwiung saengiaei, pwe ngaang itip maniuweniuw nge i mesoanosoan; pwe ina nge aaemi oawpwe meyaefi aseoseo.
Pwe yoke e ngaang ipwene fang ngaenigaemi iye e mererhaeg, nge minne ipwe iseni tae woami oawpwe aiufera iye eppaen.”

footnotes.text: yoke: eew soapwon irae eno wooan iiuweer riiurhai wakke, pwe e ammwarhiu fengaenniir igine repwe feeori eew engaang cchoaw.
